input.content: Build me a small expense sheet to show in chat. The shipped chart and table components cannot draw it, so write it as a web code view. Call the soul_write tool now with kind "SurfaceComponent" and slug "expense-sheet": first component.yaml with definitionMode "canonical", then the companion code/web.source.jsx, then the companion code/web.js. Do not ask me to confirm first.

tools.name: soul_write
tools.description: Commit a Soul artifact to the configuration repository. `kind` is a capitalised singular such as "SurfaceComponent". `slug` is the artifact's directory name. A SurfaceComponent's definition is its `component.yaml`: omit `companion` and pass `definitionMode` "canonical" to write it. `companion` names a file beside the definition, such as "code/web.source.jsx" (the authored JSX) or "code/web.js" (the compiled module its `code:` block points at).

arguments.content:
name: business.expense-sheet
version: "1.0"
description: A small expense sheet drawn by authored code.
propsSchema:
  type: object
  required:
    - rows
  properties:
    rows:
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
events: []
examples:
  - rows:
      - label: Bulbs
        amount: 40
targets:
  - channel: web
    surface: chat
code:
  web:
    source: code/web.source.jsx
    module: code/web.js
    sourceSha256: d9c2990bf173ba9f13ad682e9f9dae19b0d1e7b9efd325c39f11babfaa55c91f
metadata:
  protocol: tsp
  protocolVersion: "1.0"

script.text: I built the expense-sheet component as a web code view.

input.content: Which presentation components can you see now? Name every one.
